requirements.quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use
requirements.text: The signalling lamp shall be so designed and constructed that, in normal conditions of use and notwithstanding vibrations, its satisfactory operation remains assured and it retains the prescribed characteristics.

requirements.quote: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.text: The lamp shall bear the approval marking.

requirements.quote: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant
requirements.text: The lamp shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.

requirements.quote: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating: (a) The category or categories of light source(s) prescribed;
requirements.text: Where the lamp has replaceable light sources, it shall bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source prescribed.

requirements.quote: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage
requirements.text: Where the lamp has an electronic light source control gear, variable intensity control, secondary operating mode or non-replaceable light sources, it shall bear a marking of the rated voltage or range of voltage.

requirements.quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings
requirements.text: The lamp shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and the other markings.

requirements.quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible,
requirements.text: All markings on the lamp shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.text: The value for "a" of the approval marking shall be at least 5 mm.

requirements.quote: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.text: The approval marking of the lamp shall consist of a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the approving country.

requirements.quote: The four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2. This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.text: The lamp shall bear the four to six-digit sequential number placed close to the approval mark.

requirements.quote: The symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.text: The lamp shall bear the symbols identifying the light signalling lamp function prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.

requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.text: The lamp shall bear the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments.

requirements.quote: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.text: Where the lamp cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, it shall bear a horizontal arrow showing in which position it is to be mounted.

requirements.quote: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of: (a) Direction indicators categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12;
requirements.text: For front or rear direction indicators and front or rear position lamps and end-outline marker lamps, the horizontal arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.

requirements.quote: If applicable, to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.: (a) The additional letter "D", on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps;
requirements.text: Where the lamp may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps, it shall bear the additional letter "D" to the right side of the function symbol.

requirements.quote: (b) The additional letter "Y", on lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system.
requirements.text: Where the lamp is used as part of an interdependent lamps system, it shall bear the additional letter "Y".

requirements.quote: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.text: Where an electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control is part of the lamp but not included in the lamp body, it shall be marked with its identification number and the manufacturer's name.

requirements.quote: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part
requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part of the lamp that is not designed to be separated from the light-emitting transparent part.

requirements.quote: In any case the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle
requirements.text: The approval marking and the category of LED substitute light sources, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as a door is opened.

requirements.quote: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.text: Where the outer lens of the lamp is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both the detachable lens and the main body.

requirements.quote: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.text: Where an outer lens is shared between devices with different approval markings, the main body of each lamp shall bear only the approval marking of its own function(s).

requirements.quote: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.text: The approval marking and the trade-name, light-source-category, rated-voltage and control-gear markings shall be affixed on the lamp.

requirements.quote: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, bear the following markings. (a) On the light source module(s): (i) The trade name or mark of the applicant;
requirements.text: Where replaceable light source modules are used, each module shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.

requirements.quote: (ii) The specific identification code of the module; This specific identification code shall comprise the starting letters “MD” for “MODULE”
requirements.text: Each replaceable light source module shall bear its specific identification code beginning with the letters "MD" followed by the approval mark without the circle.

requirements.quote: (b) On the lamp: (i) The specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii);
requirements.text: Where replaceable light source modules are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module.

requirements.quote: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall: (a) On the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified
requirements.text: The luminous intensity of each of the two samples on the reference axis (HV) shall be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function.

requirements.quote: (b) In no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum, specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.;
requirements.text: In no direction where the lamp is visible shall the luminous intensity exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function.

requirements.quote: (d) Within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.text: Within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Annex 2, the luminous intensity shall be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function.

requirements.quote: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function.

requirements.quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 3.
requirements.text: For front position lamps (A) and front end-outline marker lamps (AM), the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the minimum intensity of 4 cd and maximum of 1.40∙10² cd (single lamp) given in Table 3.

requirements.quote: The colour of the light emitted shall be white, however the lamp identified by symbol MA may be amber.
requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the front position lamp shall be white.

requirements.quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 4.
requirements.text: For rear position lamps (R1) and rear end-outline marker lamps (RM1), the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the minimum intensity of 4 cd and maximum of 1.7∙10¹ cd (single lamp) given in Table 4.

requirements.quote: However, a luminous intensity of 6.0∙101 cd shall be permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5°
requirements.text: Where a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, a luminous intensity of 6.0∙10¹ cd shall be permitted below a plane forming an angle of 5° downward from the horizontal.

requirements.quote: The colour of light emitted shall be red.
requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp and rear end-outline marker lamp shall be red.

requirements.quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
requirements.text: For stop lamps (S1), the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the minimum intensity of 6.0∙10¹ cd and maximum of 2.60∙10² cd (single lamp) given in Table 7.

requirements.quote: The colour of light emitted shall be red.
requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.

requirements.quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 8 where the minimum luminous intensities shall be fulfilled:
requirements.text: For front and rear direction indicators, the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements of Table 8 with the minimum intensities fulfilled in the reference axis.
For rear direction indicators of category 2a, the minimum luminous intensity in the reference axis shall be 5.0∙10¹ cd and the maximum 5.00∙10² cd for a single lamp.

requirements.quote: The colour of light emitted shall be amber.
requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the direction indicator shall be amber.

requirements.quote: This shall be achieved by switching with a frequency of f = 1.5 ± 0.5 Hz with the pulse width greater than 0.3 s, measured at 95 per cent peak light intensity.
requirements.text: Where the direction indicator is measured in flashing mode, the switching frequency shall be 1.5 ± 0.5 Hz with a pulse width greater than 0.3 s measured at 95 per cent peak light intensity.

requirements.quote: Each light source, after its activation, shall remain lit until the end of the ON cycle;
requirements.text: Where the direction indicator flash is produced by sequential activation, each light source shall remain lit until the end of the ON cycle.

requirements.quote: The distance between two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the light emitting surface of the sequential direction indicator shall not exceed 50mm
requirements.text: For a sequential direction indicator, the distance between two adjacent distinct parts of the light emitting surface shall not exceed 50 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.

requirements.quote: The variation shall finish no more than 200ms after the beginning of the ON cycle;
requirements.text: For a sequential direction indicator, the variation shall finish no more than 200 ms after the beginning of the ON cycle.

requirements.quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 11.
requirements.text: For the rear fog lamp (F1), the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the minimum intensity of 1.50∙10² cd and maximum of 3.00∙10² cd given in Table 11.

requirements.quote: The area of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 140 cm2.
requirements.text: The area of the apparent surface of the rear fog lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 140 cm².

requirements.quote: The colour of light emitted shall be red.
requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear fog lamp shall be red.

requirements.quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10.
requirements.text: For the reversing lamp (AR), the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the minimum intensity of 8.0∙10¹ cd and the maximum intensities given in Table 10.

requirements.quote: The colour of light emitted shall be white.
requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.

requirements.quote: The rear fog lamp shall be subjected to the heat resistance test specified in Annex 6.
requirements.text: The rear fog lamp shall be subjected to the heat resistance test specified in Annex 6.

requirements.quote: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply:
requirements.text: Where a single lamp contains more than one light source, in case of failure of any one light source at least one of the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.1.2 shall apply.

requirements.quote: (a) The light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded;
requirements.text: Where a light source fails in a multi-source lamp, the light intensity shall still comply with the minimum intensities of the standard light distribution in Annex 3 and the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded when all light sources are illuminated.

requirements.quote: A signal for activation of the tell-tale prescribed in paragraph 6.5.8. of Regulation No. 48 or paragraph 6.3.8. of Regulation No. 53 shall be produced
requirements.text: For direction indicator lamps of categories 2a and 2b, a signal for activation of the failure tell-tale shall be produced on the basis of one of the options in paragraph 4.6.1.4.

requirements.quote: The lamp shall only be equipped with: - replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128
requirements.text: The lamp shall be equipped only with replaceable light sources approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, light source modules and/or non-replaceable light sources.

requirements.quote: (a) The design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one;
requirements.text: Where replaceable UN-approved light sources are used, the lamp shall be designed so that the light source can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.

requirements.quote: (b) The light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061.
requirements.text: Where replaceable light sources are used, the light source holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061.

requirements.quote: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.text: The light signalling device shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances that cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: (a) it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s); and
requirements.text: Where replaceable light source modules are used, each module shall be designed so it can only be fitted in the designated correct position and removed only with a tool.

requirements.quote: (b) it is tamperproof; and
requirements.text: Where replaceable light source modules are used, each module shall be tamperproof.

requirements.quote: (d) when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.
requirements.text: Where a light source module is replaced by another module bearing the same identification code, the photometric requirements of the device shall still be met.

requirements.quote: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
requirements.text: During photometric measurements of the lamp, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.

requirements.quote: the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.text: Where the lamp may be installed in more than one position or in a field of positions, the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the reference axis.

requirements.quote: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities of the lamp shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.

requirements.quote: The measuring equipment shall be such that the angular aperture of the receiver viewed from the reference centre of the light is comprised between 10' and 1 degree;
requirements.text: The measuring equipment shall be such that the angular aperture of the receiver viewed from the reference centre is between 10' and 1 degree.

requirements.quote: The intensity requirement for a particular direction of observation shall be deemed to be satisfied if that requirement is met in a direction deviating by not more than one-quarter of a degree
requirements.text: The intensity requirement for a particular direction of observation shall be deemed satisfied if met in a direction deviating by not more than one-quarter of a degree.

requirements.quote: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp during testing shall be 28 V for the 24 V system of the bus.

requirements.quote: shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent from the average luminous flux
requirements.text: Where the lamp is equipped with multiple replaceable light sources, it shall be operated at a setting such that the actual luminous fluxes do not deviate by more than 5 per cent from the average luminous flux.

requirements.quote: the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp or end-outline marker lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1
requirements.text: Where a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, the ratio between the measured intensities of the two lamps turned on simultaneously to the rear position lamp turned on alone shall be at least 5:1 in the defined field.

requirements.quote: The direction H = 0° and V = 0° corresponds to the reference axis.
requirements.text: The direction H = 0° and V = 0° shall correspond to the reference axis of the lamp.

requirements.quote: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light pattern should be substantially uniform
requirements.text: Within the field of light distribution shown as a grid, the light pattern of the lamp shall be substantially uniform.

requirements.quote: If visual examination of a light appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that, outside the axes, no intensity measured within the rhombus defined by the extreme directions of measurement is below 7.5∙101 cd
requirements.text: For the rear fog lamp, where visual examination reveals substantial local variations of intensity, no intensity measured within the rhombus defined by the extreme directions of measurement shall be below 7.5∙10¹ cd.

requirements.quote: For all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either - after 30 minutes of operation, or - after photometric stability has occurred
requirements.text: For lamps using non-incandescent technology, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and after 30 minutes of operation or photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

requirements.quote: Direction Indicator Cat 1, 2, 11, 12 0.2 HV
requirements.text: For direction indicators, the luminous intensity shall be checked at 0.2 s after switch ON at the reference coordinate HV.

requirements.quote: Front direction indicator (1, 1a, 1b) 45°/80° (20°/80°) a 15°/15° (15°/5°) b
requirements.text: For the front direction indicator, the minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility shall be 45° inboard and 80° outboard and the minimum vertical angles 15° above and 15° below.
For front and rear position lamps, the minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility shall be 45° inboard and 80° outboard and the minimum vertical angles 15° above and 15° below.
For the stop lamp, the minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility shall be 45° inboard and 45° outboard and the minimum vertical angles 15° above and 15° below.

requirements.quote: The lamp shall be subjected to a one-hour test of continuous operation following a warm-up period of 20 minutes. The ambient temperature shall be 23 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.text: The rear fog lamp shall be subjected to a one-hour test of continuous operation after a 20-minute warm-up at an ambient temperature of 23 °C ± 5 °C.

requirements.quote: After the lamp has been stabilized at the ambient temperature, no distortion, deformation, cracking or colour modification shall be perceptible.
requirements.text: After the heat resistance test, no distortion, deformation, cracking or colour modification of the rear fog lamp shall be perceptible.

requirements.quote: At that measurement the values shall reach at least 90 per cent of the values obtained before the heat resistance test on the same lamp.
requirements.text: After the heat resistance test, the measured intensity values shall reach at least 90 per cent of the values obtained before the test on the same lamp.

requirements.quote: An assembly of two independent lamps to be type approved as lamp marked "D" is applicable to front and rear position lamps, stop lamps
requirements.text: Where the front or rear position lamps or stop lamps are type approved as an assembly of two independent lamps marked "D", the assembly shall comply with the requirements for maximum intensity with all lamps lit and minimum intensity if either lamp has failed.

requirements.quote: (b) Size: the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
requirements.text: Where a manufacturer logo is incorporated in the lens of a position lamp, the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm².

requirements.quote: (d) Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.text: The stop lamps, direction indicator lamps and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a manufacturer logo.

requirements.quote: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of: (e) A direction indicator of category 2b emitting more than the maximum value of category 2a;
requirements.text: Where a variable intensity control is used on a category 2b direction indicator, in case of its failure the steady luminous intensity requirements of category 2a shall be fulfilled automatically.

requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be so constructed that it functions satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.

requirements.quote: In addition, they must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to its efficient operation or maintenance in good condition.

requirements.quote: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.text: The components of the retro-reflector shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.

requirements.quote: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean. The surface shall therefore not be rough and any protuberances they may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall be easy to clean, not rough, and any protuberances shall not prevent easy cleaning.

requirements.quote: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
requirements.text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflector when in normal use.

requirements.quote: Retro-reflectors may consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, which must be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.text: Where the retro-reflector consists of a combined optical unit and filter, they shall be designed so they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.

requirements.quote: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.
requirements.text: The colouring of the retro-reflecting optical units and filter by paint or varnish shall not be permitted.

requirements.quote: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet: (a) The dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5;
requirements.text: The Class IA retro-reflector, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7, shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.

requirements.quote: (b) The photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.;
requirements.text: The Class IA retro-reflector shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements specified in paragraphs 5.1.4 to 5.1.5.

requirements.quote: the ten samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6
requirements.text: The ten submitted retro-reflector samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6.

requirements.quote: The two samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants
requirements.text: Two retro-reflector samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test and then, if satisfactory, to the resistance to fuels and lubricants tests.

requirements.quote: The two samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face
requirements.text: Two retro-reflector samples shall be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6 and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face.

requirements.quote: The two samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
requirements.text: Two retro-reflector samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test of Part 6 of Annex 6.

requirements.quote: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors must be equal to or greater than those in Table 3
requirements.text: For a red Class IA retro-reflector, the RI values shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3 for the corresponding divergence and illumination angles.
For a red Class IA retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 20', the minimum RI values shall be 3.00∙10² mcd∙lx⁻¹ at β1=β2=0°, 2.00∙10² at β1=±10°, and 1.00∙10² at β2=±20°.

requirements.quote: in the case where a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB, is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values are verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.text: Where the Class IA retro-reflector is installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.

requirements.quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux must be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the light reflected by the retro-reflector shall be within the night-time colour limits for red specified in UN Regulation No. 48.

requirements.quote: Part 1 of Annex 6 Heat: 48 h at 65° ± 2°C
requirements.text: The retro-reflector samples shall be subjected to the heat test of 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C followed by visual inspection for distortion.

requirements.quote: Part 3 of Annex 6 Water: 10 min. in normal position 10 min. in inverted position visual inspection
requirements.text: The retro-reflector samples shall be subjected to the water test of 10 min in normal position and 10 min in inverted position followed by visual inspection.

requirements.quote: Part 4 of Annex 6 Corrosion: 24 hours 2 hours interval 24 hours visual inspection
requirements.text: The retro-reflector samples shall be subjected to the corrosion test of 24 hours, a 2-hour interval and 24 hours followed by visual inspection.

requirements.quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings
requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier or approval marking and the other markings.

requirements.quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.text: All markings on the retro-reflector shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.

requirements.quote: in case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface
requirements.text: Where the Class IA retro-reflector requires a rotation indication, the word "TOP" shall be inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface.

requirements.quote: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.
requirements.text: The approval marking or Unique Identifier and the trade-name markings shall be clearly legible on the retro-reflector.

requirements.quote: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.text: The approval mark of the retro-reflector shall consist of a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the approving country.

requirements.quote: The symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall bear the class symbol "IA" identifying the retro-reflective device as prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.

requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter “R” and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall bear the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments.

requirements.quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” is defined in Table 1.
requirements.text: The value for "a" of the approval marking on the retro-reflector shall be at least 5 mm as defined in Table 1 for symbol IA.

requirements.quote: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0°
requirements.text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflector, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0°.

requirements.quote: White retro-reflective devices must not produce a selective reflection, that is to say, the trichromatic coordinates "x" and "y" of Standard Illuminant "A" must not undergo a change of more than 0.01
requirements.text: Where the retro-reflector is white, it shall not produce a selective reflection, i.e. the trichromatic coordinates x and y shall not change by more than 0.01 after reflection.

requirements.quote: When the RI of a retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the device.
requirements.text: When the RI of the retro-reflector is measured for β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the device.

requirements.quote: retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5°. The RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.
requirements.text: Where the retro-reflector is marked "TOP", it shall be rotated about its axis ±5° and the RI shall not fall below the prescribed value in any position during this rotation.

requirements.quote: Angular diameter of the source - δ≤10' Angular diameter of the measuring device - γ≤10' Angular diameter of the illuminated area - η≤80'
requirements.text: The measuring geometry used for the retro-reflector photometry shall have a source angular diameter δ ≤ 10', a measuring device angular diameter γ ≤ 10' and an illuminated area angular diameter η ≤ 80'.

requirements.quote: The measuring distance shall be chosen in such an order that at least the limits for the angles δ, γ and η given above and illustrated in Figure A4-III are respected, but not lower than 10 m.
requirements.text: The measuring distance for the retro-reflector photometry shall be chosen so that the angular limits are respected but shall not be lower than 10 m.

requirements.quote: The variation in the value of the illuminance shall then comply with the condition: max/min ≤ 1.05
requirements.text: The illuminance over the useful area of the retro-reflector, measured perpendicular to the incident light, shall comply with max/min ≤ 1.05.

requirements.quote: The photometer head shall be corrected to the spectral luminous efficiency for the CIE standard photometric observer in photopic vision.
requirements.text: The photometer head used for retro-reflector measurement shall be corrected to the spectral luminous efficiency for the CIE standard photometric observer in photopic vision.

requirements.quote: Correction of residual stray light should always be allowed for by measuring it when the sample is covered by an opaque matt black surface
requirements.text: When measuring the retro-reflector, residual stray light shall be corrected for by measuring it with the sample covered by an opaque matt black surface and subtracting it.

requirements.quote: the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2 though the surfaces of the retro-reflecting optical units need not necessarily attain this area.
requirements.text: For photometric measurements of the Class IA retro-reflector, the illuminating surface shall be limited to 100 cm² within a circle of 200 mm diameter.

requirements.quote: In the case where more than one or a range of different axis of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the photometric measurements shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference
requirements.text: Where more than one or a range of axes of reference is specified for the retro-reflector, the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each axis or the extreme axes of the range.

requirements.quote: The shape of the illuminating surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surface of the Class IA retro-reflector shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape from an observation distance of 10 metres.

requirements.quote: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
requirements.text: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit of the retro-reflector.

requirements.quote: immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water
requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be immersed for 10 minutes in water at 50 °C ± 5 °C with the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface 20 mm below the water surface.

requirements.quote: Immediately after completion of the test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.text: Immediately after the corrosion test, the retro-reflector shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair its efficiency.

requirements.quote: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.
requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector, in particular the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the 70/30 n-heptane/toluol test mixture.

requirements.quote: It must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.text: After the fuel resistance test, the retro-reflector shall not show any apparent surface changes, slight surface cracks being acceptable.

requirements.quote: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil, and after 5 minutes cleaned and its RI measured.

requirements.quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.text: The lamp assembly, as an electrical/electronic sub-assembly, shall be designed, constructed and fitted so that the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, complies with the EMC requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.quote: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.text: The lamp assembly shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions and for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz
requirements.text: The broadband electromagnetic radiation generated by the lamp assembly shall not exceed 62 to 52 dBµV/m in the 30 to 75 MHz band and the other limits of paragraph 6.5.2.1.

requirements.quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.text: The measured broadband emission values of the lamp assembly, expressed in dBµV/m, shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz
requirements.text: The narrowband electromagnetic radiation generated by the lamp assembly shall not exceed 52 to 42 dBµV/m in the 30 to 75 MHz band and the other limits of paragraph 6.6.2.1.

requirements.quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured value, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.text: The measured narrowband emission values of the lamp assembly, expressed in dBµV/m, shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.quote: Maximum allowed pulse amplitude for Polarity of pulse amplitude Vehicles with 12 V systems Vehicles with 24 V systems Positive +75 V +150 V Negative -100 V -450 V
requirements.text: For the lamp assembly on a 24 V system, the maximum allowed transient pulse amplitude shall be +150 V for a positive pulse and -450 V for a negative pulse on the supply lines.

requirements.quote: Test level below 2 GHz 60 V/m 75 V/m 60 mA 30 V/m 21 V/m
requirements.text: The lamp assembly shall withstand, in over 90 per cent of the 20 MHz to 2 GHz band, immunity test levels of 60 V/m (stripline), 75 V/m (TEM cell), 60 mA (BCI), 30 V/m (ALSE) or 21 V/m (reverberation chamber).

requirements.quote: Test level below 2 GHz 50 V/m 62,5 V/m 50 mA 25 V/m 18 V/m
requirements.text: The lamp assembly shall withstand minimum immunity test levels over the whole 20 MHz to 2 GHz band of 50 V/m, 62.5 V/m, 50 mA, 25 V/m or 18 V/m depending on the test method.

requirements.quote: Test level above 2 GHz Not applicable Not applicable Not applicable 10 V/m 7 V/m
requirements.text: The lamp assembly shall withstand, in over 90 per cent of the 2 to 6 GHz band, immunity test levels of 10 V/m (ALSE) or 7 V/m (reverberation chamber).

requirements.quote: The ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
requirements.text: The lamp assembly shall show no degradation of performance of its immunity related functions (direction indicators, stop lamps, end-outline marker lamps, rear position lamp) during the immunity tests.

requirements.quote: Test pulse number Immunity test level Test duration / number of pulses FPSC for ESA: 12V system 24V system Related to immunity related functions
requirements.text: The lamp assembly shall be tested for immunity to transient disturbances on the 24 V supply lines using test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to ISO 7637-2 at the levels given in Table 3b.

requirements.quote: 1 -75 V -450 V 500 pulses III III
requirements.text: For the lamp assembly on a 24 V system, test pulse 1 shall be applied at -450 V for 500 pulses with functional status III.

requirements.quote: 3a -112 V -150 V 1 h I III
requirements.text: For the lamp assembly on a 24 V system, test pulse 3a shall be applied at -150 V for 1 h with functional status I for immunity related functions.

requirements.quote: Starting profile II II 10 pulses (for ESA which shall be operational during engine start phases)
requirements.text: Where the lamp assembly is operational during engine start phases, the starting profile shall be applied at level II for 10 pulses.

requirements.quote: Where a vehicle or electrical/electronic system or ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2.
requirements.text: Where the lamp assembly contains no electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with the narrowband emission requirements of paragraph 6.6.2.

requirements.quote: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.
requirements.text: Where the lamp assembly is not switched, contains no switches and includes no inductive load, it need not be tested for transient conducted emission and is deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.

requirements.quote: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.text: Every lamp assembly conforming to an ESA type approved under this Regulation shall be affixed with the international approval mark.

requirements.quote: A circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.text: The EMC approval mark on the lamp assembly shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the approving country.

requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1. above.
requirements.text: The EMC approval mark on the lamp assembly shall comprise the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle.

requirements.quote: Markings on ESAs in conformity with paragraph 5.3. above need not be visible when the ESA is installed in the vehicle.
requirements.text: The EMC approval mark on the lamp assembly need not be visible when the assembly is installed in the vehicle.

requirements.quote: The sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
requirements.text: The sample of the lamp assembly submitted for EMC testing shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.

requirements.quote: the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
requirements.text: During broadband emission measurement of the lamp assembly, the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the interference limits of paragraph 6.5.2.1.

requirements.quote: For ESA other than involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" the test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
requirements.text: For the lamp assembly, the broadband emission test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.

requirements.quote: The test shall be performed according to ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
requirements.text: For the lamp assembly, the narrowband emission test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.

requirements.quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.text: The narrowband emission limits shall apply throughout the 30 to 1,000 MHz frequency range for the lamp assembly.

requirements.quote: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.text: Immunity measurements of the lamp assembly shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.quote: AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range;
requirements.text: The immunity test signal applied to the lamp assembly shall be amplitude modulated with 1 kHz and 80 per cent depth in the 20 to 400 MHz range.

requirements.quote: ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion
requirements.text: The lamp assembly may comply with the immunity requirements using any combination of the absorber chamber, TEM cell, bulk current injection, stripline and reverberation chamber test methods.

requirements.quote: Spectrum analysers and FFT-based instruments, that meet the requirements of CISPR 16-1-1, may be used for conformity measurements.
requirements.text: Spectrum analysers and FFT-based instruments used for the emission testing of the lamp assembly shall meet the requirements of CISPR 16-1-1.

requirements.quote: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation
requirements.text: The lamp set shall be so fitted that, under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding vibrations, it retains the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and it is not possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.

requirements.quote: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road
requirements.text: When fitted to the vehicle, the reference axis of each light-signalling lamp shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road and, except for side devices, perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane within ±3°.

requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions lamps constituting a pair shall: Be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane
requirements.text: Each lamp constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane.

requirements.quote: Satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.text: The two lamps of a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.

requirements.quote: Have substantially identical photometric characteristics.
requirements.text: The two lamps of a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics.

requirements.quote: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of the lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which it is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.

requirements.quote: Stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are not permitted to be reciprocally incorporated.
requirements.text: The stop lamps and direction indicator lamps shall not be reciprocally incorporated.

requirements.quote: Their apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, based upon the areas bounded by the outline of their light emitting surfaces, do not overlap.
requirements.text: Where stop lamps and direction indicator lamps are grouped, their apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis shall not overlap.

requirements.quote: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.text: All lamps of the set shall, when installed on the bus, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6.

requirements.quote: Direction-indicator lamps, the vehicle-hazard warning signal, amber side-marker lamps complying with paragraph 6.18.7. below, and the emergency stop signal shall be flashing lamps.
requirements.text: The direction indicator lamps shall be flashing lamps.

requirements.quote: the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.text: Where the power supply condition is not covered by paragraph 5.27.1, the voltage at the terminals of the lamp shall not exceed 28 V (24 Volt-System) by more than 3 per cent.

requirements.quote: the edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis farthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle
requirements.text: For the front and rear direction indicator lamps, the edge of the apparent surface farthest from the median longitudinal plane shall be not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall not be less than 600 mm.
requirements.text: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the direction indicators in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm.

requirements.quote: The height of the direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b, measured in accordance with paragraph 5.8., shall not be less than 350 mm and not more than 1,500 mm.
requirements.text: The height of the front and rear direction indicator lamps above the ground shall be not less than 350 mm and not more than 1,500 mm.

requirements.quote: Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°;
requirements.text: Where a direction indicator lamp is mounted below 750 mm, the downward vertical geometric visibility angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.quote: All direction-indicator lamps on one side of a vehicle shall be switched ON and OFF automatically as defined by applicable UN Regulations and/or by means of one control and shall flash in phase.
requirements.text: All direction indicator lamps on one side of the bus shall be switched ON and OFF by one control and shall flash in phase.

requirements.quote: The light shall be a flashing light flashing 90 ± 30 times per minute.
requirements.text: The direction indicator light shall flash at 90 ± 30 times per minute.

requirements.quote: Operation of the light-signal control shall be followed within not more than one second by the emission of light and within not more than one and one-half seconds by its first extinction.
requirements.text: Operation of the direction indicator control shall be followed within not more than one second by the emission of light and within not more than one and one-half seconds by its first extinction.

requirements.quote: Operating tell-tale mandatory for direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b.
requirements.text: An operating tell-tale shall be provided for the direction indicator lamps of categories 1 and 2a.

requirements.quote: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant braking signal.

requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm.
requirements.text: For the S1 category stop lamps, the distance between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm.

requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: Above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm
requirements.text: The height of the S1 category stop lamps above the ground shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm, or 2,100 mm where the bodywork makes it impossible and optional lamps are not installed.

requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
requirements.text: The horizontal geometric visibility angle of the S1 category stop lamps shall be 45° to the left and 45° to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: Towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.text: The stop lamps shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: In the case of a trailer, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 150 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.text: For the front position lamps of the bus, the point on the apparent surface farthest from the median longitudinal plane shall be not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm
requirements.text: The front position lamps shall be mounted at a height above the ground of not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm.

requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards and 80° outwards.
requirements.text: The horizontal geometric visibility angle of the front position lamps shall be 45° inwards and 80° outwards.

requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.text: The vertical geometric visibility angle of the front position lamps shall be 15° above and 15° below the horizontal.

requirements.quote: Forwards.
requirements.text: The front position lamps shall be oriented forwards.

requirements.quote: In width: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.text: For the rear position lamps, the point on the apparent surface farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall be not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm
requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be mounted at a height above the ground of not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm, or 2,100 mm where the bodywork makes it impossible and optional lamps are not installed.

requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards and 80° outwards.
requirements.text: The horizontal geometric visibility angle of the rear position lamps shall be 45° inwards and 80° outwards.

requirements.quote: Devices of F or F1 or F2 categories: Mandatory.
requirements.text: A rear fog lamp of category F1 shall be fitted to the bus.

requirements.quote: if there is only one rear fog-lamp, it shall be on the opposite side of the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle to the direction of traffic prescribed in the country of registration
requirements.text: Where only one rear fog lamp is fitted, it shall be on the opposite side of the median longitudinal plane to the direction of traffic prescribed in the country of registration.

requirements.quote: In height: not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,000 mm above the ground. For rear fog lamps grouped with any rear lamp the maximum height may be increased to 1,200 mm.
requirements.text: The rear fog lamp shall be mounted at a height above the ground of not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,000 mm, or 1,200 mm where grouped with any rear lamp.

requirements.quote: α = 5° upwards and 5° downwards; ß = 25° to right and to left.
requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear fog lamp shall be 5° upwards and 5° downwards vertically and 25° to the right and 25° to the left horizontally.

requirements.quote: The rear fog-lamp(s) cannot be switched ON unless the main beams, dipped-beams or front fog-lamps are switched ON;
requirements.text: The rear fog lamp shall not be able to be switched ON unless the main beams, dipped beams or front fog lamps are switched ON.

requirements.quote: In all cases, the distance between the rear fog-lamp and each stop-lamp shall be greater than 100 mm.
requirements.text: The distance between the rear fog lamp and each stop lamp shall be greater than 100 mm.

requirements.quote: Two devices mandatory and two devices optional on all vehicles with a length exceeding 6,000 mm, except vehicles of category M1.
requirements.text: Where the bus length exceeds 6,000 mm, two reversing lamps shall be mandatory.

requirements.quote: In height: not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.text: The reversing lamps shall be mounted at a height above the ground of not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm.

requirements.quote: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.
requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the reversing lamps installed at the rear shall be 15° upwards and 5° downwards, and 45° outwards and 30° inwards where there are two.

requirements.quote: They shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be able to be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and the propulsion system control is in a position permitting operation.

requirements.quote: Mandatory on vehicles exceeding 2.10 m in width.
requirements.text: Where the bus width exceeds 2.10 m, front and rear end-outline marker lamps of categories AM and RM1 shall be mandatory.

requirements.quote: Two visible from the front and two visible from the rear.
requirements.text: The end-outline marker lamps shall comprise two visible from the front and two visible from the rear.

requirements.quote: Front and rear: as close as possible to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.text: The front and rear end-outline marker lamps shall be positioned as close as possible to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, within 400 mm of it.

requirements.quote: Rear: At the maximum height compatible with the requirements relating to the width, design and operational requirements of the vehicle and to the symmetry of the lamps.
requirements.text: The rear end-outline marker lamps shall be fitted at the maximum height compatible with the width, design and operational requirements of the bus and the symmetry of the lamps.

requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 80° outwards. Vertical angle: 5° above and 20° below the horizontal.
requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the end-outline marker lamps shall be 80° outwards horizontally and 5° above and 20° below the horizontal vertically.

requirements.quote: The position of an end-outline marker lamp in relation to corresponding position lamp shall be such that the distance between the projections on a transverse vertical plane of the points nearest to one another on the apparent surfaces
requirements.text: The position of an end-outline marker lamp in relation to the corresponding position lamp shall be such that the distance between their nearest apparent-surface projections on a transverse vertical plane is not less than 200 mm.

requirements.quote: Two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.text: Two rear retro-reflectors shall be fitted, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors of UN Regulation No. 150.

requirements.quote: In width: that point on the illuminating surface which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.text: For the rear retro-reflectors, the point on the illuminating surface farthest from the median longitudinal plane shall be not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: In height: Above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm
requirements.text: The rear retro-reflectors shall be mounted at a height above the ground of not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm, or 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp.

requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 30° inwards and outwards. Vertical angle: 10° above and below horizontal.
requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflectors shall be 30° inwards and 30° outwards horizontally and 10° above and 10° below the horizontal vertically.

requirements.quote: Rearwards.
requirements.text: The rear retro-reflectors shall be oriented rearwards.

requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps and the end-outline marker lamps can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.text: Where an interdependent lamp system is used, all its light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.quote: No account shall be taken of lighting devices fitted for the interior lighting of the vehicle nor of reversing projections.
requirements.text: Red light emitted by a rear lamp shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle, and white light emitted by a front lamp shall not be visible from the rear.

requirements.quote: the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp
requirements.text: The visibility requirement shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of red light emitted to the front or white light emitted to the rear is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp.

requirements.quote: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component
requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the position lamps, direction indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component in any fixed position.

requirements.quote: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
requirements.text: With the exception of the retro-reflectors, each lamp shall be able to be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.

requirements.quote: shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools
requirements.text: Where the lamp is approved with replaceable light sources of UN Regulation No. 37, it shall be fitted so the light source can be correctly replaced without expert assistance and without special tools other than those provided with the vehicle.

requirements.quote: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity.
requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity.

requirements.quote: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed
requirements.text: Where, when the lamp is installed, any part of its apparent surface is hidden by further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the non-hidden part still conforms to the prescribed photometric values.

requirements.quote: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed
requirements.text: Where rear lamps with variable luminous intensity control are used, their intensity shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion and the prescribed intensity ratios shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.

requirements.quote: No sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
requirements.text: No sharp variation of intensity of a variable-intensity lamp shall be observed during transition.

requirements.quote: Vehicle unladen and one person in the driver's seat;
requirements.text: For the M3 bus, the loading condition of the vehicle unladen with one person in the driver's seat shall be used when determining dipped-beam angle variation.

requirements.quote: Vehicles laden such that each axle carries its maximum technically permissible load or until the maximum permissible mass of the vehicle is attained
requirements.text: For the M3 bus, the laden loading condition shall be such that each axle carries its maximum technically permissible load or the maximum permissible mass is attained, whichever occurs first.
